verses.1: And the two magicians came in at noon. Lot was sitting at the gate of Sodom. When he saw them, he got up to answer their call. He bowed down in reverence.
verses.2: And he said, “Please go into your master’s house. Wash your feet and rest. Then go your way.” But they refused to do so.
verses.3: And he prepared food for them in great quantities. He also made drinks and desserts for them. They ate everything that he provided.
verses.4: Before they lay down, the people of the city, the people of Sodom, stood up on the rooftops. Everyone from young men to old men stood up. The entire population stood up together.
verses.5: They called out to Lot and said to him, “Where are those men who came to you this evening? Let’s go and find them.”
verses.6: And he went out to them; then the door was closed behind him.
verses.7: And he said, “Oh brothers, please be careful.”
verses.8: Please give me two daughters who are unknown to anyone. Please show them kindness according to your own standards. But only for those people who truly deserve it. Do not do anything that would be contrary to what they deserve. They have come here in the light of God’s truth.
verses.9: And they said, “Let’s go!” And one of them said, “Now, let’s break down the door.” They tried to do so, but it was too difficult. So they went to break down the door.
verses.10: And they sent their men to bring them the door and the lock. They closed the door.
verses.11: And those people who were at the entrance of the house were beaten with sticks, from a young age until they grew up. They tried to find the door.
verses.12: And the people said to Lot, “Why are you leaving here with your guests, your sons, your daughters, and everything you have in this city?”
verses.13: For we are destroying this place, because their cries have reached Jehovah’s ears. So Jehovah has sent us to destroy it.
verses.14: And he went out and spoke to his heirs, those who were supposed to inherit his daughters’ property. He said, “Come out of this place! For the LORD is about to destroy the city.” This was seen by his heirs as a sign that the city would be destroyed.
verses.15: And just as the darkness rose, the demons urged Lot to say, “Get up, take your wife and two daughters with you! Do not stay in this city, or else you will be destroyed.”
verses.16: And she became stronger. The men strengthened with his help, along with his wife and his two daughters. With the power of Jehovah upon him, they drove him out of the city.
verses.17: And when they were brought out, he said to them, “Put your hands in the air. Do not look at those around you. And stand on all the high hills.” He commanded that they should be put in chains so that they would not be able to escape.
verses.18: And Lot said to them, “Please, my gods!”
verses.19: Please, let your servant find favor in your eyes. Let your kindness increase, for you have done this for me, so that I may be able to live. I cannot climb up the mountain, otherwise, evil will cling to me and I will die.
verses.20: Please, let this city be close to us. It’s still in a young state. But it’s not yet fully developed; it needs more time to grow and become more prosperous.
verses.21: And he said to him, “Now, I have brought your face forward to this matter. But I will not destroy the city that you mentioned.”
verses.22: Hurry up, get up! I can’t do anything until you arrive. That’s why the city was named “Zoar”.
verses.23: The sun rose over the earth, and darkness covered it.
verses.24: And Jehovah poured fire and sulfur upon Sodom and Gomorrah. From heaven, Jehovah sent these flames upon them.
verses.25: And it turned those cities and all their buildings, as well as all the people who lived in those cities, into rubble. The land became barren and useless.
verses.26: And his wife stood behind him, and she became a judge.
verses.27: And Abraham went there in the morning, to the place where Jehovah’s face was located.
verses.28: And it covered the faces of Sodom and Gomorrah, as well as all the faces of the land of Egypt. Then it saw that the ground became like a field covered with thorns.
verses.29: And in His anger, God destroyed the cities of the Kikkar. Then God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out from among the people who lived there.
verses.30: And Lot went up to the mountain, and his two daughters stayed with him. He was afraid of staying in the valley, so he went up to the mountain, where he and his two daughters stayed.
verses.31: And the old woman said to the young woman, “Our father is old. There is no one in this world who can take our place and lead us along the path of all people.”
verses.32: Let us kiss our Father’s lips, and lie down with Him. Let us live from our Father’s lineage.
verses.33: And they kissed their father in the night. Then she entered the room, lay down next to her father, and did not know it while she was lying there, asleep.
verses.34: And in the evening, the older woman said to the younger woman, “I have slept with my father last night. Let’s sleep together too, and live from our father’s seed.”
verses.35: And they also kissed each other in that night. The young woman woke up and lay down beside him. She didn’t know whether she was asleep or awake.
verses.36: And they were born to him from his two daughters.
verses.37: And the priest gave birth to a son. His name was Moab. He became the father of Moab, all the way up to this day.
verses.38: And the young woman also gave birth to a son. They named him Ben-Ami. He became the father of his people, until today.
